scope: Read-only review of root Windows resource-manager adapter, four prepared tests and transport shutdown insertion. No additional investigation beyond requested versions.

resolved_finding.topic: active worker gate before resource-manager retirement
resolved_finding.resolution: Adapter rejects active!=0 before taking the state lock or mutating readiness; transport calls it after the active check and configuration retirement.
resolved_finding.test_limit: The test injects active status; it does not claim an actual surviving-worker race was exercised.

static_observations.observation: Initialization holds launch then resource state; nested backend operations take short bank locks. No reverse resource->launch path or callback into this state mutex was identified in reviewed paths.
Record and Arc keepalive are installed before source initialization; errors retain native allocation inventory and last_error; state is removed only after successful retire_empty.
Borrowed scratch4 is confined to produce. Generic Record tracks every successful allocation before fallible publication and its retirement does not retain scratch4.
Comments and snapshot retain explicit false claims for complete original startup and real provider connectivity.

Prepared test withholds only final allocation ownership token, expects prior thirteen frees once, bank/global lifetime retained, then restores token and retries. It does not simulate physical free success reported as failure.

verification_limits: Static bounded review only; test outcomes await root qualification.
Mutex poisoning, panic/abort and side-effecting custom deallocator contracts are not dynamically exercised.
No populated-provider lifetime, full normal startup or nonempty UI proof.
